remarks: Views for miles! This 8th floor unit at Regency Towers looks over downtown Stamford and beyond out to Long Island Sound. South facing, there is great sunlight year round. The balcony off the living room is perfect for morning coffee, dinner al fresco or to just sit and watch the spectacular sunsets and July 4th fireworks are spectacular from Stamford and surrounding towns! An open floor plan with 2 bedrooms 2 baths, the property features a huge living room, dining room, eat-in Kitchen in addition. There are six huge closets, classic parquet floors and a reserved parking space in the underground garage. Regency Towers has an on-site superintendent, professional door staff, upgraded security system, a generator (powers common areas & elevators if a blackout) and the HOA includes heat, hot water and cooking gas. With some tender care, this will be a spectacular home for years to come!
